current_evidence: The council's 'Planning validation guidance notes' page links this 'Local planning validation guidance' (with the companion 'Validation Matrix') as the only local list, the cover says 'March 2023', and a web search found no newer Lichfield list.

issues.detail: The List date 2023-10-01 comes from the PDF ModDate metadata. The document's cover gives 'March 2023'. The list is now over two years old, past the two-year review period the document itself states, so the 'Outdated' flag is right.

The Householder row says '(none)', but the list applies several requirements to householder applications: Parking / Access Arrangements; Water Quality Assessment (all applications except LBC and adverts, including householders not draining to mains foul sewer); River Mease SAC Impact Assessment (dwelling extensions in the River Mease catchment); Daylight / Sunlight Assessment; Planning and Sustainability Statement for householders in the Green Belt; and Heritage Statement and Tree Survey where relevant. The Validation Matrix also marks Site Layout Plan and Existing/Proposed Elevations as Required for Householder.
issues.evidence: 'All applications (including domestic householder) proposing built structures / extensions.' (Parking/Access); 'All applications (except Advertisements and Householders not in the Green Belt)' (Planning and Sustainability Statement)

issues.detail: Both Habitats Regulations requirements specific to Lichfield are missing as named rows. The Cannock Chase SAC Impact Assessment applies to all applications that lead to a net increase in visitors and to certain residential units. The Cannock Chase SAC Unilateral Undertaking applies to residential development within 15 km of the SAC. The River Mease SAC Impact Assessment applies to all new residential units in the River Mease catchment. Fragments of the Cannock Chase text appear only inside the EIA and S106 rows.
issues.evidence: 'For all new residential units within the River Mease catchment.'; 'For residential development within 15km of the Cannock Chase Special Area of Conservation'

issues.detail: Many requirements in the list have no row: Landscaping Scheme (all applications except householder, LBC, adverts and change of use); Surface Water Drainage Strategy (all major developments); Water Quality Assessment; Topographical Survey; Open Space Assessment; Playing Fields Assessment; Landscape Visual Impact Assessment; Land Contamination Assessment; Lighting Assessment; Noise and Vibration Assessment; Coal Mining Risk Assessment (foundations in Coal Authority high-risk areas, excluding householder); Utilities Statement (50+ dwellings or 10,000 sq m+); Waste Audit / Site Waste Management Plan; Daylight / Sunlight Assessment; Employment Land Assessment; town centre sequential and retail impact assessment; Statement of Agricultural Need; Statement of Community Involvement (all major applications); Structural Survey (barn conversions and demolition); Telecommunication Supporting Information (including prior notifications); Viability Assessment; Photographs / Photomontages; and Parking / Access Arrangements.
issues.evidence: Surface Water: 'All major developments should be accompanied by a sustainable drainage strategy.'; SCI: 'All major applications, and major change of use applications.'; Landscaping: 'All applications (excluding Householder, Listed Building Consent, Advertisements and Change of Use)'

issues.detail: The Affordable Housing Statement is placed under Outline, but the source explicitly excludes outline applications. It applies to residential developments of 15 or more units other than outline applications, so it belongs under Full planning and Reserved matters.
issues.evidence: 'Residential developments of 15 Units (excluding Outline applications) or over'

issues.detail: The Lawful development cert row lists 'Arboricultural Impact Assessment / Tree Survey'. Its excerpt is actually the Heritage Statement text for conservation areas, Registered Parks and Historic Hedgerows, preceded by a council phone number. Nothing in the source applies a tree survey or heritage statement to LDC applications, and the 'Application type named in requirement text' note is wrong (it probably matched 'LDC', which here stands for Lichfield District Council).
issues.evidence: Excerpt: '276580 LDC Arboricultural Officers 01543 308174 NPPF A Heritage Statement for development in or adjacent to a Conservation Area ...'

issues.detail: About 17 rows are tagged 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' (for example Air Quality, Flood Risk, Transport Assessment, Travel Plan and Ventilation). The list and the Validation Matrix apply most of these conditionally to Full, Outline, Reserved Matters and S73 alike, so Outline and Reserved matters are under-populated.
issues.evidence: Validation Matrix key: 'C – Conditional - see relevant section (dependent on site and application context)'

issues.detail: Several triggers are table headers or garbled fragments, not triggers. Air Quality's excerpt is just column headings ('Health Document Air Quality Assessment Policy Driver When is Document Required ...'); the real trigger is emissions of pollutants with national air quality objectives, large car parks and major construction. Block plan's excerpt is '/ proposed block plan drawings.' Flood Risk's excerpt is 'accompanied by a Flood Risk Assessment.'; the real trigger is Flood Zones 2 and 3, or 1 ha or more in Flood Zone 1. Pre-application advice's excerpt is 'specified in pre-application advice.'
issues.evidence: Air Quality: 'Applications that will give rise to emissions to air of pollutants for which there is a national air quality objective'; FRA: Flood Zones 2/3 and FZ1 sites of 1 ha or more

issues.detail: The Environmental Statement (EIA) excerpt merges in the Cannock Chase SAC lead-in ('The following information should be submitted to assess the impact of new development on the Cannock Chase Special Area of Conservation'). The Planning Obligations / S106 excerpt is the Cannock Chase SAC mitigation text with garbage ('3900 ... nts/made'). The real S106 Heads of Terms trigger is all major applications and residential schemes of one or more dwellings.
issues.evidence: Planning Obligations / Draft Heads of Terms: required for all major applications and residential schemes of one or more dwellings

issues.detail: The Design and Access Statement excerpt is generic national text, not the local trigger: all major development, new dwellings or new buildings over 100 sq m in conservation areas, and listed building applications. The 'Planning Statement' row captures only the affordable-housing viability sentence and misses the local 'Planning and Sustainability Statement', which is required for all applications except adverts and householders outside the Green Belt. The Heritage Statement row captures only the archaeology clause and omits listed buildings, conservation areas and demolition in conservation areas.
issues.evidence: Planning and Sustainability Statement: 'All applications (except Advertisements and Householders not in the Green Belt)'

issues.detail: The CIL row's excerpt omits the specific trigger: extensions over 100 sq m to certain retail uses, new dwellings (not apartments) and new retail units. It also carries a generic 'only where council is a CIL charging authority' note, although Lichfield is a charging authority. The Validation Matrix marks the CIL Question Form as Required for all application types.
issues.evidence: 'Community Infrastructure Levy ... All planning applications that comprise any of the following:'

issues.detail: Under 'Drawing / document standards' there are three near-identical items ('All plans must include a linear scale bar ... and be given a (unique) plan / drawing reference number'), plus a fourth location-plan variant. The 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' and 'Foul Sewage / Utilities Statement' rows use the same foul-drainage excerpt, and neither gives the real SuDS trigger (all major development).
issues.evidence: Tab items 4-6 differ only in punctuation and the word 'unique'

issues.detail: The 'Submission rules' items are process text, not local requirements: apply via the Planning Portal or on paper, and sign hard-copy certificates by hand. The tab item 'An existing site plan ... showing the layout of winter and summer pitches' is a niche drawing note, probably from a caravan or gypsy site section, presented as a general drawing standard.
issues.evidence: 'Applicants should apply electronically through the Planning Portal However paper copies will be accepted.'

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Lichfield local list (cover dated March 2023, not the October 2023 metadata date), but the extraction is thin. Householder is wrongly shown as having no local requirements, the Cannock Chase and River Mease SAC requirements and about 20 other items are missing, Affordable Housing is put under Outline although the source excludes outline, and many triggers are table headers or garbled fragments.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
